summary: This file contains only data constants — no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It provides colormap RGB tuples and class name lists for ADE20K (150 classes) and VOC2012 (21 classes) semantic segmentation datasets, used for visualizing segmentation masks.

constants.ADE20K_COLORMAP: List of 150 RGB tuples defining colors for each ADE20K segmentation class
constants.ADE20K_CLASS_NAMES: List of 150 class name strings for the ADE20K dataset (empty string for background)
constants.VOC2012_COLORMAP: List of 21 RGB tuples defining colors for each VOC2012 segmentation class
constants.VOC2012_CLASS_NAMES: List of 21 class name strings for the VOC2012 dataset (empty string for background)

example_usages.import_ADE20K_COLORMAP: import ADE20K_COLORMAP from colormaps to get RGB colors for 150 ADE20K segmentation classes
example_usages.import_ADE20K_CLASS_NAMES: import ADE20K_CLASS_NAMES from colormaps to get human-readable names for ADE20K dataset classes
example_usages.import_VOC2012_COLORMAP: import VOC2012_COLORMAP from colormaps to get RGB colors for 21 VOC2012 segmentation classes
example_usages.import_VOC2012_CLASS_NAMES: import VOC2012_CLASS_NAMES from colormaps to get human-readable names for VOC2012 dataset classes
example_usages.lookup_class_color: use ADE20K_COLORMAP[class_id] to retrieve the RGB color tuple for a given segmentation class index
